about: The crawl unit's outcome table — the contract BOTH drivers assert. Each row is one scenario the Rust unit (crawl/unit/tests.rs) and the Python unit (tests/arbitrage/test_crawl_unit_parity.py, driving _registration_unit) drive over its own fixture of the same shape: the unit kind, the summary breakdown tag (null = the outcome records no breakdown entry), and the stage that answered the unit (build_paths.py's UNIT_STAGES).

rows.about: a fresh closed cycle: all five stages run, a new path id is created
the same cycle re-sighted: the registered-path memo's dup fast-path answers before verify
a hop whose stable build refusal is already a pool fact answers the unit before any build
a V4 pool whose static fee exceeds the executor's 2-byte field: a stable build skip that counts
the same encoder-limit V4 pool re-sighted: the pool fact answers at the memo stage
a malformed V4 edge with no on-chain pool id
an operator pin whose hop count disagrees with the path
the path-composition policy denies a touched token; the deny enters the rejected-path memo
the same denied path re-sighted: the rejected-path memo answers without re-running the policy
the registered-path cap refuses the registration: the benign stop
a structurally unroutable hop list: a transient register failure, never memoized
